Please check the following page for details. [https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/yokosuka-tunnel-koji/](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/yokosuka-tunnel-koji/) - [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/icon_train.png)About N'EX](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/) - [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/icon_ticketing.png)Tickets](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/) - [Ticket Guide (How to Buy)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_ticket) - [Using a Pass (How to Buy)](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_pass) - [Reserving Seats](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/nex/tickets/#nex_reservation) You can board the N’EX in one of two ways: 1) with a ticket, or 2) with a pass. ## 1\. Ticket Guide (How to Buy) ### Reference image for ticket usage Paper Basic Fare Ticket + Super (Limited) Express Train ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img01.png) or Suica (IC card) + Super (Limited) Express Train ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img02.png) | Departure and arrival at Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station | Ordinary Car | Green Car (first class) | | --- | --- | --- | | Tōkyō | ¥3,140 | ¥3,910 | | Shinagawa
Shibuya
Shinjuku | ¥3,330 | ¥4,100 | | Yokohama | ¥4,480 | ¥6,750 | | Ōfuna | ¥4,810 | ¥7,080 | Fares and charges related to transport to Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3 Station #### Notes - In addition to a regular Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat ticket, Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets are available with pre-selected boarding dates and routes and unspecified carriages and seats. - Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets are equal in price to Limited Express Trains reserved seat tickets. - When using a Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket, please use the vacant seats found in the carriages. Customers can specify their carriages and seats at no extra charge once they have decided on a train to board. - Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket can be purchased even if a train does not have any vacant seats. Please use the deck areas in this case. You may also sit if you find a vacant seat. Refunds cannot be made if there are no vacant seats. - Same price throughout the year. - Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat tickets and Basic Fare Tickets for a child (6 to 11 years old) are half the price of adult tickets. However, Green Tickets for a child share the price of those for adults. - A toddler (1 to 5 years old) and baby (11 months and under) may board free of charge, but a child ticket is required in the following cases. - When three or more toddlers accompany one adult or a child (tickets are required for the third and any additional toddlers). - When a toddler or baby occupies his or her own reserved seat or Green Car seat. - When a toddler travels alone.Conditions are subject to change. ### How to Purchase Tickets #### Purchasing a pass online Tickets can be reserved and purchased from overseas through JR-EAST Train Reservation. You can check the train times by searching via station of arrival/departure information. [Reserve seats online here \\ \\ JR-EAST Train ReservationOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) #### Purchasing at the station Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat ticket for the N'EX can be purchased up to one month prior from the boarding date. Please make your purchases at JR EAST Travel Service Center, the JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi), or a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine. ##### JR EAST Travel Service Center ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_tsc.svg) We support our customers' journeys with JR EAST's vast railroad network of Shinkansen trains, limited express trains, and trains that run through the Eastern Japan area. Find out about how you can exchange passes for convenient railway transport, sightseeing information, and access various services including those for purchasing. [Click here for more information about the JR EAST Travel Service Center](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/customer_support/) ##### JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_midori.svg) Basic Fare Tickets for limited express trains, all domestic Shinkansen including the Narita Express, and Green Car Super (Limited) Express Train reserved seat tickets can be purchased at the JR Ticket Office (Midori-no-Madoguchi). [Station Map for Major Stations](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/e/stations/) ##### Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine The Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine’s services are available in multiple languages allowing customers to purchase tickets and follow the on-screen instructions in their preferred language (English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, and Korean). We accept banknotes of 1,000 yen, 2,000 yen, 5,000 yen, and 10,000 yen. Credit cards are also accepted. ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/ticket/img/renew/img/purchase_img_05.jpg) ## 2\. Using a Pass (How to Buy) ### Reference image for pass usage Pass + reserved seat ticket ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_img03.png) ## Recommended pass for a great deal when using the Narita Express ### [N'EX TOKYO Round Trip Ticket](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/nex.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_nex_map.png) Recommended for those traveling from Narita Airport to Shibuya, Shinjuku, Tōkyō, and other areas! Round-trip usage within the 14-day validity period **¥5,200** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ### [JR EAST PASS](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/eastpass.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_jep_map.png) Recommended for those who want to travel around all of Eastern Japan! Valid for 5 days / Unlimited rides **¥35,000** ​ Valid for 10 days / Unlimited rides **¥50,000** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ### [JR TOKYO Wide Pass](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/pass/tokyowidepass.html) ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/nex_pass_twp_map.png) Recommended for those traveling to areas near Tōkyō, such as Nikkō! Valid for 3 days / Unlimited rides **¥16,000** ​ [Purchase here Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) \\* From the linked reservation site, select "Purchase a pass" and select the appropriate pass. ## Reserving seats ### Riding in reserved seats (including Green Cars) You can reserve a seat using any of the options below. - Reserved seats (excluding Green Car seats) are available at no additional charge. - Same-day seat reservations are also available at JR Ticket Offices (Midori-no-Madoguchi) and reserved seat ticket vending machines equipped with passport readers at stations inside Narita Airport. - Make reservations up to one month in advance for a smoother trip! [![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/customer_support/img/train_reservation.png)Opens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) [Reserve seats onlineOpens in a new window](https://www.eki-net.com/en/jreast-train-reservation/Top/Index) - Reserve your seat without standing in line! ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_machine.png) Reserve seats using a Reserved Seat Ticket Vending Machine Reserved seat ticket vending machines are installed at almost all stations in the Tōkyō metropolitan area. Click [here](https://www.jreast.co.jp/estation/facility_search.aspx?SearchCategoryCd=3) for locations (Japanese only) - A trusty concierge to support your journey! ![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/nex/img/tickets/tickets_tsc_logo.png)![](https://www.jreast.co.jp/multi/pass/img/img_seat-reservations01.png) [Reserve seats at a station](https://www.jreast.co.jp/en/multi/customer_support/) ### Riding without a seat reservation - Customers who have a Limited Express Unreserved Seat Ticket - Customers who wish to purchase a Super (Limited) Express Train ticket onboard - Customers without a designated seat who have purchased a discount ticket such as the JR EAST PASS **Please use the vacant seats of the Ordinary Cars.** - \\* The Green cars are unavailable. - \\* Tickets will be checked on-board, so please have your Limited Express Unreserved Seat Tickets and Discount tickets at hand. **If a passenger arrives with a reserved seat ticket, please offer your seat to them.** - \\* In such cases, please move to another available seat or the vestibule area.
